entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Compiled models generate non-aot compatible code (repo included) #36817
  • CSharpMigrationsGenerator ignores SqlOperation.SuppressTransaction #36815

Closed

  • Cosmos: DbSet<DerivedType> throws an exception when an enum discriminator is used #36329
    10.0.0
  • Discriminator on derived type is being incorrectly updated with integer value of enum (EF Core CosmosDB provider) #34852
    10.0.0
  • System.NullReferenceException when using a Dictionary in a Json field #36805
  • [Regression] Unmapped property access over complex types fails in EF 10 (EF.Property<T> method may only be used within Entity Framework LINQ queries) #36761
  • Wrong ExecuteUpdate handling when setting complex type with multiple nested properties with same name #36791
    10.0.0
  • ElementAtOrDefaultAsync return type should be nullable (TSource?) for reference types #36813
  • Cosmos SDK. GetCosmosClient is not thread safe which leads to 503s #36714
    10.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36816
  • JSON and association test fixes #36814
    Servicing-approved, tell-mode

Merged

  • [rc2] Fix Cosmos enum discriminator handling #36770
    Servicing-approved, ask-mode
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36812
  • [rc2] Stop transforming complex property access to EF.Property #36786
    Servicing-approved, ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix ExecuteUpdate parameters for multiple properties with same name #36792
    Servicing-approved, ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix race condition in SingletonCosmosClientWrapper.Client #36767
    Servicing-approved, ask-mode
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36811
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36810
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36806

Updated

  • SQL Server: Don't transform equality to bitwise operations in predicate contexts #36809
  • Use `PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys` instead of `PRAGMA foreign_keys` when migrating #35873
    community-contribution
  • [rc2] SQL Server: Don't transform equality to bitwise operations in predicate contexts #36797
    Servicing-approved, ask-mode
